[SWS_CM_00086] Precondition for Skeleton destruction
⌈
To avoid dangling refer-
ences to
Event
sample data (referred to by a
ara::com::SampleAllocateePtr
)
which has not yet been handed back to communication management by the application,
it is required that all
Event
sample data that has been allocated with the
Allocate
()
method, is either
• sent (using the
Send()
method defined in [SWS_CM_90437])
• released by calling either
–
ara::com::SampleAllocateePtr::operator=(nullptr)
–
ara::com::SampleAllocateePtr::reset()
